messages:
olivia: Hey team — AcmeCorp (acct: acme-781) flagged a huge spike in reserved GPU hours on their March invoice. Dashboard shows ~12h/day last week but invoice consumed ~240 reserved hours. They only reported ~50k tokens/day. Can someone triage?

anna-cs: Thanks — I opened a support ticket and got the invoice ID and pool. Invoice INV-2026-03-07, pool p-78-eu-west1. Customer says SLA credits briefly appeared then were removed.

mike.billing: Copy. Do we know if burst was engaged or if they had any Dedicated -> Hosted fallbacks? Any recent config changes on that pool?

olivia: Burst was enabled. No fallbacks reported by customer. They sent a sample request and timestamps around the first high burn window (2026-03-06 01:58 to 02:12 UTC). Also attached a curl they used for health probes:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/p-78/invoke \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" \n  -H "X-Probe-Id: " \n  -d '{"ping":true}'
```

(missing X-Probe-Id header — customer said their probe tool dropped it on retries)

billing-bot: metering-job-2026-03-06T02:05 processed pool=p-78, events=1248, attributed_reserved_hours=240, backfill=false

kevin-sre: I'm pulling metering logs now. Past incidents show warmup/prewarm probes can be double-counted when probe-id header is missing and our dedupe key relied on that header. Will check retry traces + probe IPs.

mike.billing: Running a quick query on metering service to look for duplicate-attribution by src_ip + pool + minute. SQL snippet: 

```sql
SELECT src_ip, pool_id, minute_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hits, SUM(billed_hours)
FROM metering.events
WHERE pool_id='p-78'
  AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-06T01:50:00Z' AND '2026-03-06T02:20:00Z'
GROUP BY src_ip, pool_id, minute_bucket
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Result shows ~320 duplicate events from 3 src_ips during the spike window; billed_hours sums to ~240h.

kevin-sre: Found the chain — our recent probe change (PR #5123) changed the dedupe key to use header X-Probe-Id only. When that header is empty we fell back to generating a UUID per attempt, so retries were seen as distinct probes and each was billed. The customer probe tool retries 3x by default.

olivia: Customer verified their probe config had intermittent header drops during a network flake, so retries fit the pattern. They also said SLA credits showed then auto-reversed around 02:30 UTC.

mike.billing: Two actions proposed: 1) immediate provisional credit for the overbilled reserved hours while we reprocess, 2) engineering reprocess metering for pool p-78 with dedupe-by-ip+pool+minute and dedupe-old-header-fallback. How many hours should we credit interim?

anna-cs: Customer requested provisional coverage for 200 hours while investigation continues. They need a response within 24h for their finance team.

kevin-sre: I can prepare a reprocess job. Steps: a) mark reprocess window 2026-03-06T01:50–2026-03-06T02:20, b) run dedupe pass using (probe_id if present) OR (src_ip, pool_id, minute_bucket) when probe_id missing, c) regenerate reserved_hour aggregates, d) produce a reprocessed invoice diff. Estimated ETA: 48 hours for backfill + verification.

mike.billing: I'll issue provisional credit 200h now and note as pending adjustment against INV-2026-03-07. After reprocess, we'll either finalize credit or adjust. I'll CC finance.

kevin-sre: Root cause summary for postmortem: PR #5123 introduced exclusive reliance on X-Probe-Id for dedupe; absent header led to UUID per attempt -> duplicate billing on retries. Fix: change dedupe logic to fallback to stable tuple (src_ip, pool_id, minute_bucket) and add conservative rate-limit on probe attribution. I'll open an ops PR with tests.

olivia: Thanks. Please ping me when reprocess starts so I can update AcmeCorp. Also need a short blurb for the customer outlining cause and next steps.

mike.billing: Acknowledged — provisional credit applied, ticket updated (SUP-7891). Will send draft blurb after engineering posts PR.

anna-cs: Customer notified of provisional credit and ETA. They replied :thumbsup:.

kevin-sre: PR opened (#5230) with fallback dedupe logic and a unit test covering missing probe-id. Scheduling backfill job for 2026-03-07 10:00 UTC. I'll post logs and final numbers in this thread when done.

olivia: Great — thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.
